chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Use a staff, for it is among the sunnahs of my brothers, the Prophets, and the young and the old of Banu Isra'il used to walk with the staff so that they would not become haughty in their walk.

key_terms.إِخْوَانِيَ: my brothers, referring here to the Prophets
key_terms.يَخْتَالُوا: to act haughtily or walk with conceit

ai.seo_question: Why did Imam Ali عليه السلام recommend carrying a staff while walking or traveling?
ai.summary: Imam Ali عليه السلام encourages carrying a staff, presenting it as a practice of the Prophets. He also cites the example of Banu Isra'il, whose young and old used staffs as a means of avoiding arrogance in the way they walked.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.2412 - Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"Use a staff, for it is among the practices of my brothers, the Prophets. The children and the elders of Banu Israel would walk with staffs so that they would not become haughty in their walking."
